summary: Second part of a reading of Ben Shapiro's book Porn Generation, which attacks comprehensive sex education, champions abstinence-only programs and blames liberals and the Clinton-Lewinsky scandal for corrupting American youth, using selective data and possibly invented interviewees.

evidence.note: Host says this continues the reading of Shapiro's Porn Generation, which he dates to 2013
Host finds a 2005 Shapiro book titled Generation Sex, likely the same book under another title
Shapiro defends fear-based abstinence teaching; hosts cite evidence it fails
Hosts search for quoted Harvard interviewees and suspect they were made up
Book's account of early sex hygiene campaigns against venereal disease
Bush-era doubling of federal abstinence-only funding discussed
2010 and 2011 studies contrasted with the book's 2002 Heritage Foundation source
Chapter blaming the Clinton-Lewinsky scandal for exposing children to oral sex
Episode closes by reading the parental abdication section, about 11 percent into the book

notes: Hosts date Porn Generation to 2013; it was actually published in 2005 (the 2005 Generation Sex they find is likely an earlier title of the same book). Per the prompt, time follows the transcript (end 2013); reviewer may want 2005. Covered span starts at the 1998 Lewinsky chapter. Studies from 2010-2011 are host rebuttals, not story years. Part one is the separate story ben-shapiro-wrote-a-book-about-sex.
